story.intro: Powerhouse is a novel concept of a super store for electrical and electronic products in Pakistan — one destination where architects, engineers, contractors and homeowners can see, compare and specify genuine products from over 100 global brands under a single roof.
paragraphs: Founded in Karachi, Powerhouse set out to solve a persistent problem in the Pakistani construction market: counterfeit gear, fragmented suppliers and specifications that didn't survive the site. We built a curated, authorised distribution house instead — premium switches, lighting, building automation, industrial switchgear, security and Hi-Fi/AV systems, all backed by certificates of origin and manufacturer warranty.

Today our teams work across residential towers, hospitality, commercial fit-outs and industrial plants in Karachi and Islamabad, advising from first drawing to final commissioning. Whatever the scale, the promise is the same: genuine products, honest specification and support that continues long after installation.
With display centres in DHA Karachi and an office on Golra Road, Islamabad, every product on this site can be seen, touched and tested before you specify it.

values.title: Authenticity First
values.text: Authorised distribution and direct factory imports only. Every item ships with provenance you can verify.

values.title: Consultative Honesty
values.text: We specify what suits your project and budget — not what sells fastest. Price on request, always transparent.

values.title: Design-Led
values.text: Lighting and automation are design disciplines. We support architects and interior teams with real layouts, not catalogues.

values.title: Built for Site
values.text: Products chosen for Pakistani power conditions, dust and load profiles — installed and serviced by our own technicians.

teams.title: Lighting & Design Studio
teams.text: Lighting designers and DALI/automation specialists who translate architecture into ambience, lux levels and control scenes.

teams.title: Project & Site Engineering
teams.text: Electrical engineers and certified technicians for load calculations, cable scheduling, installation and commissioning.

teams.title: Systems & Integration
teams.text: AV, security, networking and building-automation integrators who program KNX, Crestron, Sonos and access-control systems end to end.

teams.title: Sales & Supply Chain
teams.text: Specifiers who source 100+ brands, manage BOQ quotations, imports and on-time delivery to site.

services.title: Planning & Design
services.tagline: From first drawing to a buildable electrical specification.
services.text: Powerhouse engineers and lighting designers work alongside your architect from concept stage — load studies, circuit schedules, lux-planned lighting layouts, automation schematics and AV drawings, then a itemised BOQ with genuine product selections.

services.title: Installation & Wiring
services.tagline: Certified technicians, safety protocols, clean handover.
services.text: Our own installation crews execute what we specify: containment, wiring, mounting of switches, fittings, panels and devices, termination of switchgear, and full commissioning of automation, security and AV systems with testing records.

services.title: Maintenance & Support
services.tagline: Support that continues long after handover.
services.text: Annual health checks for lighting, automation and security systems, genuine spare parts from our stocked brands, reprogramming and scene updates, and priority call-outs for commercial and industrial clients.
